scenes.title: Intro
scenes.narration: Now let us look at AI Portfolio Recommendation from the Stakeholder side: the view for investment committee members, clients, or anyone who needs to review results without changing them.

scenes.title: Sign in as Stakeholder
scenes.narration: Stakeholders sign in the same way. Enter a name, and pick the Stakeholder role, which is read-only.

scenes.title: Portfolio view
scenes.narration: The header switches to Portfolio View, and the badge confirms you are signed in as a Stakeholder. You are looking at the same project the Admin set up.

scenes.title: Key numbers
scenes.narration: The key numbers are all here: growth, drawdown, risk-adjusted return, and how many buy, hold and sell signals are active right now.

scenes.title: Read-only by design
scenes.narration: What is missing is intentional. There are no quick actions to run backtests, change scenarios or create projects, so the numbers you review cannot be altered by accident.

scenes.title: Personalise
scenes.narration: Viewers can still personalise their experience, like switching to dark mode for a late-night review.

scenes.title: Sign out
scenes.narration: When you are done, sign out from the top right. The session ends, and you are back at the login screen.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.narration: That is the Stakeholder view: clear, read-only access to the portfolio. Thanks for watching.
